newsitem.title: USA: US corporate debt mart slow on day after Superbowl.
newsitem.headline: US corporate debt mart slow on day after Superbowl.

text.p: Trading of U.S. corporate bonds was generally sluggish on Monday prompting some traders to speculate that many U.S. investors were recuperating from festivities related to the U.S. football championship game on Sunday.
"People have Superbowl hangover and no one came out to play today," said one investment-grade bond trader. "This was one of the slowest days I've ever seen."
Despite the malaise in the broader markets, the high-yield sector experienced pockets of intense activity.
